_comment: SIRINE brand kit for the creative lab. Mirrors remotion-studio/src/sirine/theme.ts + strings.ts and the owner rules recorded in ad-engine memory. The compiler reads ONLY from here + the store product — never invents offer facts.
audience: Algerian women 22–45 buying bags/shoes/packs for themselves or as a gift; price-sensitive, COD-trusting, mobile-first; Darija first.

ar-DZ.inspect: افحصي سلعتك قدام الليفرور قبل ما تخلصي

fr.inspect: Vérifiez votre colis devant le livreur avant de payer

look: Premium-minimal, monochrome brand frame (black/white/cream) around warm, true-to-life product colour. Soft daylight or clean studio light; real textures; no neon, no glossy CGI, no fake luxury props.

9:16.note: Reels UI owns y<270 and y>1250 (captions, CTA, icons).

4:5.note: Feed: keep text 60 px from edges; primary text sits above the media.

never: AI-generated text, logos, brand marks or price inside the image — all text is composited in the editor
invented packaging, boxes, shopping bags or tissue unless a real packaging photo is an approved reference
a mute 'talking' AI face, lip-sync avatars or fake testimonials
products, colours or accessories that are not in the store listing
luxury-brand marks, monograms or 'inspired by' references (Hermès, Chanel, Polène, Zara…)
SFX/whooshes on scene cuts; aggressive or fast cut pace on talking footage
raw URLs in the primary text; static utm_content values
the Arabic word نقش/منقوش (vulgar in Darija) and «حتى لباب دارك» (trips the HOUSING lint) — use «توصيل حتى لعندك»
copy_rules: One language per creative (ar-DZ default). Brand name, price digits and CTA enum don't count as mixing.
Western digits (0-9) for prices, even in Arabic. Price format: 4,200 دج / 4 200 DA.
Inspection promise wording only: «افحصي سلعتك قدام الليفرور قبل ما تخلصي» (never 'try it on').
Price, crossed price and gift must match the store product exactly (LP parity).
On ≤5 s COD videos, price + «الدفع عند الاستلام» must be legible at frame 0 and stay on screen.

defaults.music: licensed bed only (owner-approved list); never model-generated audio
